# Cooling Planner

> A browser simulator that compares environment, water/power resources, representative-cow heat loss and daily milk (hypothesis model) across equipment placements and roof conditions in a model barn. Not definitive real-farm prediction - a reduced-order model under representative conditions.

## Remote MCP (Model Context Protocol)

A stateless remote MCP exposes the calculation model to external agents.

- Endpoint: https://puzxplbkg2qglia72tkhs2z7km0jrusa.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/ (streamable HTTP, Bearer auth)
- Tools: `get_default_project` (default Project JSON), `evaluate` (applies an operation list to a clone and computes heat/water/milk), `compare_candidates` (constrained daily-result comparison of 1-3 candidates), `describe_model` (model structure, assumptions, limits), `get_doc` (documents backing the model theory)
- Public demo token (freely usable; rate abuse → rotation): `demo-581fKusGqNgk7YrycFNw6M_5`
- Client config: `{"type":"http","url":"https://puzxplbkg2qglia72tkhs2z7km0jrusa.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/","headers":{"Authorization":"Bearer demo-581fKusGqNgk7YrycFNw6M_5"}}`

## Returning a proposal to the browser

- `evaluate` returns the edited `project`. Give this object to the user as a JSON file (schema 10) or JSON text. The browser accepts a plain Project or the full evaluate response containing `project` (schema 9 input is auto-migrated).
- Use the browser's Load for a file, or "Import MCP scenario JSON" under Compare / "Settings & save" for pasted JSON. The browser validates inputs and recomputes; supplied results are ignored. Maximum 2 MiB.
- Mean/max deficits are 60-minute fixed-weather diagnostics across representative points; daily water/power use a separate 24-hour operation schedule. Averages do not establish that every location is adequately cooled.
- Representative-day hourly weather: set `update_daily_weather` with `mode:"hourly"` and 24 rows (`hour` 0–23, ascending, `temperatureC`/`relativeHumidityPct`/`solarRoofWm2`). It affects only the daily aggregation (`dailyThermal`/`dailyMilk`); the 60-minute points always use the fixed `environment`.
